name: ovos-stt-plugin-wav2vec2
description: This is an OVOS speech-to-text (STT) plugin for Wav2Vec2 models. It loads a Wav2Vec2 model from Hugging Face and transcribes audio with it. If you do not set a model, the plugin picks one for you based on the language.
author: OpenVoiceOS
